image_prompt.text: Broken stone platforms floating in open air over a bottomless pit, separated by gaps and crossed by leaps or fallen spans
Ancient eldritch monoliths rising out of the abyss, tall enough to orient a player from anywhere in the zone
Dark purple void crystals growing in clusters from the rock walls and platform edges
Eerie glowing runes carved into the stone of the platforms and monoliths
Twisted dead trees clinging to the rim and ledges of the abyss

notes: Classification: the prompt self-declares 'Fantasy RPG', so RPG leads even though no combat, quest, or progression loop is described. It was close to no-genre — the text is almost entirely a place and a mood — and the declaration was the deciding signal.

No preset fitted: every RPG preset assumes a town, shops, mobs, or gates, none of which the prompt mentions. Taking Dungeon Crawler would have meant swapping its shape and dropping all three of its options, which is building from scratch, so preset is null.
Shape: world-single, because the prompt describes one self-contained abyss zone with no hub, no instanced areas, and no second biome. This also keeps the build off P4/P3, which are not ready.

CHECK comes from island-cluster: platforms floating over a bottomless pit are only a problem if the play volume self-occludes. If they are laid out as a single tier of platforms over a void it should resolve as an ordinary P0 build; layered platforms above and below each other would not.

Did not take terrain-relief for the underground setting — the prompt names no hills, cliffs, or canyon in its own words, and the pit and its platforms are already carried above. If the abyss is meant to be a roofed cavern rather than an open chasm, that becomes P2 and is worth revisiting.

would have asked: Sounds like one continuous underground zone rather than a hub with separate dungeons — a single map of floating platforms strung over a bottomless pit, with eldritch monoliths as landmarks, void crystals, glowing runes, and dead trees. Want it built that way, or as a safe hub feeding into the abyss as a separate instanced area?
would have asked: Does anything live down there — hostile spawns, a boss, NPCs — or is the abyss meant to be empty? Nothing hostile was mentioned so no hazard-aggro or spawner-npc was taken.

would have asked: Are the floating platforms stacked at different heights above one another, or spread across roughly one level? That is the difference between a straightforward build and one that needs the volumetric check.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
